items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Eddie Cantor come down there, he sang 'Margie,' Row, Row, Row' and he used to sing a whole lot of numbers and I used to catch them

ctx.x: You say you want to tell me something about Boston and Eddie Cantor.
Yeah, Eddie Cantor, see, I used to play down on Suntaug Lake Inn, down in Lynnfield, Massachusetts about 17, nearly 20 miles outside of Boston.
